labels: Bar end at your shoulder, brace

text.setup: One end of the bar in a landmine or a corner, the other end in one hand at the front of your shoulder. Stand square-on, feet hip-width, a slight lean into the bar.
cues: Press the bar up and forward along its arc, not straight up.
Let your shoulder blade move round your ribs as the arm reaches.
Lower under control back to the front of your shoulder.
mistakes: Leaning back to turn it into a standing incline press.
Twisting the hips to push the bar instead of the arm.
Shrugging the shoulder up to your ear at the top.
